requirements.text: The operator signs in and sees the tickets; a wrong credential yields a generic error and unauthenticated users cannot query the tickets API.
acceptance: Valid credentials show the ticket list
Wrong credentials return a generic error
Unauthenticated API call is rejected

requirements.text: The operator creates a ticket with an optional note of up to 200 characters; a unique number and state PREPARING are assigned and persist across API restarts.
acceptance: Ticket created with unique number and PREPARING
Note longer than 200 characters is rejected
Ticket survives an API restart

requirements.text: Tickets move PREPARING -> READY -> PICKED_UP only; no skips or regressions; concurrent requests do not corrupt state.
acceptance: Valid transitions succeed
Skips and regressions are rejected
Concurrent transitions leave a consistent state

requirements.text: Ticket list with state filter and pagination of 20, deterministic order; loading, empty, error and retry states are visible.
acceptance: Filter by state works
Pages hold 20 tickets in a deterministic order
Loading, empty, error and retry are visible

requirements.text: Only a supervisor can cancel a non-picked-up ticket; an operator calling the API directly is denied.
acceptance: Supervisor cancels a ticket
Operator receives a denial on the API

requirements.text: Keyboard-usable interface at 390 and 1440 px viewports without unjustified horizontal scroll; state is not conveyed by color alone.
acceptance: Keyboard-only flow works
No horizontal scroll at 390 and 1440 px
State has a non-color indicator

requirements.text: Server-side input validation; notes render as text, never executable HTML.
acceptance: Invalid input is rejected by the server
Notes are escaped when rendered

requirements.text: README with install, example env variables without secrets, migration, seed and test commands; basic health endpoint.
acceptance: README lists install, env, migration, seed and test commands
Health endpoint responds

assumptions.statement: Sessions use an HTTP-only cookie with server-side expiry.
assumptions.reason: The PRD requires authentication but does not choose a strategy.
assumptions.impact: Affects the auth module and CSRF handling.
